title: Archive through August 11, 2003 - Anonymous (Saturday, July 26, 2003 - 06:44 pm)
content: I was having my tonsils removed and the doctor’s knife slipped and I started bleeding. I felt myself raising up out of my body and then looked down and saw me laying on the operating table. I heard the doctor tell the nurse that my heart had stopped beating and saw nurses hurrying around me. I then seemed to fly in the air and go into a tunnel of bright lights and beams of various other colors were bouncing off the side of each wall but I was heading really fast towards an even more bright light. I had this wonderful feeling of being free, loved and very happy. Suddenly I could see a tall man dressed all in white at the end of the tunnel and as I neared him, he raised up his right hand and I just stopped flying but I seemed to be floating now. I wanted so badly to go pass him into an opening of beautiful colors but he told me “no, it is not time now. You must go back because you have a lot to do first.” the man turned his right hand just slightly and I was flying very fast through the tunnel and I felt myself fall back into my body. I awoke and saw my parents at my side and I tried to tell them my experience because I was so excited about it but I couldn’t talk. I was bleeding heavily and my vocal cords had been severed. It took me more than a year before I could talk and then I could not say “s’s” or “a’s” for a long time. I still have trouble pronouncing some words. When I finally was able to tell my experience to my parents I was told that I was a witch anyway because I was born with a “veil on my face” at birth. I also was born dead and it took 2 doctors to bring me to life and my color was bad when my mother first saw me. She rejected me at birth and most of my life.

arrival.other_being_detail: A tall man dressed all in white at the end of the tunnel.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tunnel of bright lights; beams of various other colors bouncing off the side of each wall; an opening of beautiful colors.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told: “You must go back because you have a lot to do first.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Tonsil removal surgery; doctor’s knife slipped and bleeding began.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with viewing the body, then rapid movement through a tunnel toward a bright light; encounter with a man in white who stops the experiencer and instructs return; rapid return through tunnel into body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Post-event physical injury described: severed vocal cords, prolonged inability to speak and ongoing pronunciation difficulty; later family reaction labeling experiencer “a witch” due to being born with a “veil on my face.” Also reports being “born dead” and revived by two doctors, and maternal rejection.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “no, it is not time now. You must go back because you have a lot to do first.”
